# M3-11: Categorize pipeline

- Milestone: M3
- Branch / worktree: `t/M3-11`, `../YNAB_AutoCategorizer.wt/M3-11`
- Depends on: M3-3, M3-4, M3-1c
- Touches (exclusive while running): classify/
- Plan refs: §3.2, §3.3, R5, R6, BACKLOG "What the active plan means for M3" and Plan questions 1
- YNAB access: none
- Deploy: no (smoke: none; ships in M3-17)

## Goal
One `Run` per sync takes eligible transactions through guardrails, rules and the model, then logs a decision and either applies, asks, or (in dry-run) shows what it would do.

## Scope
- Modes `off`, `dry_run`, `auto`, all behind interfaces (`Applier`, question store, `Model`).
- `Run` receives a `classify.Calibration` value (τ, model, hashes, auto_eligible) defined here and passed in by `cmd/` from `calibrate.Current()`. `classify` must not import `calibrate`, which imports `classify`.
- `auto` is effective only if that value has `auto_eligible=true` and its model, policy hash and candidates hash match this run. Otherwise run as `dry_run` and return a warning for the status message. τ comes only from that value (0.8 in dry-run if it's the placeholder).
- Compute the effective mode at the start of every `Run` and publish it through an injected setter (`func(mode)`, wired to `writer.Gate` by `cmd/`) before anything can apply.
- In effective `auto`, close every `open` or `pending` `dry_run_check` row with reason `superseded_by_auto` and update its message. They are never posted or applied.
- Questions: posting a new question for a transaction closes any open one on the same transaction (`superseded`).
- Eligible: uncategorized or unapproved, unlocked, within `CLASSIFY_BACKLOG_DAYS` (default 45), newest first, at most a set number per run. In effective `auto`, a transaction dated before `AutoSince` (when set) is never written or asked about.
- A transaction with a current decision for this model + policy + candidates + effective mode isn't sent to the model again. A decision made in another mode isn't current, so going live or returning from a downgrade re-decides new transactions instead of leaving them stranded.
- Failed model call or null result: no decision, retried next run, counted in the result. Never a question or a default (§3.2 step 5).
- Decision logic: rule → apply path. Jev p_top ≥ τ → apply path. Else claude second opinion, advisory only (logged in `second_opinion`, shown as a hint, never applied), then ask with the top-3.
- A second-opinion failure doesn't stop the question.
- Dry-run: every decision becomes a `dry_run_check` question saying "would apply X" or "would ask", so it can be judged. Nothing calls `Applier`.
- Question cap: at most 5 open (configurable). Others wait as `pending` and are posted as slots free, without re-classifying.
- Auto: rules and τ-pass rows are batched to `Applier` with actor `system`, via `scheduler`, and `approved=true`.
- Per-run ctx bound. Every outcome goes to `decisions`.

## Out of scope
- Scheduler wiring (M3-14b). Audit (M5). Intents (M5). Writing the backlog at go-live (M3-golive decides).

## Acceptance (each must be demonstrably checked)
- [ ] Table test over fakes for each path: guardrail skip, rule, τ pass, τ miss.
- [ ] Test: model error writes no decision and no question, and retries next run.
- [ ] Test: dry-run never calls `Applier`.
- [ ] Tests: `auto` with a hash mismatch or `auto_eligible=false` behaves as `dry_run` and warns.
- [ ] Test: the claude second opinion can't cause an apply, even at p=1.0.
- [ ] Test: the 6th question stays `pending`, posts when a slot frees, and calls the model once.
- [ ] Test: a decided transaction isn't re-sent to the model.
- [ ] Test: in effective `auto`, a row older than `AutoSince` is neither applied nor asked.
- [ ] Test: moving to effective `auto` closes open and pending `dry_run_check` rows and posts none.
- [ ] Test: the setter is called with the effective mode before any `Applier` call, including on a downgrade.
- [ ] Test: a `dry_run` decision isn't current in `auto`; returning from a downgrade re-decides and closes the older open question.
- [ ] `go list -deps ./classify | grep -c YNAB_AutoCategorizer/calibrate` → 0.
- [ ] go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./... green

## Supervisor note (from M3-4 review, agy low)
`llm.ModelID` is hardcoded as `"claude-cli-2.1.312/haiku"`. When the pipeline writes a `decisions` row from the LLM
second opinion, record the model id the runner actually used (from the runner/config), so τ calibration and the
decision log stay bound to the real model. Don't edit `llm/`; if that needs an `llm/` change, list it under Follow-ups.

## Result
- Status: DONE
- What changed:
  - `classify/pipeline.go`: `Pipeline`/`Config`/`Run(ctx, Calibration) (Result, error)`; `classify.Calibration` (no
    `calibrate` import); interfaces `Store` (met by `*store.DB`), `Applier` (met by `*writer.Writer`), `Asker`
    (`Ask(id)`, `Closed(q, reason)`); setter `SetMode func(writer.Mode)` (wire to `gate.Set`).
  - Effective mode computed once per Run after loading candidates (needs the candidates hash), published before
    anything else; if loading candidates fails, publishes `dry_run` (fail-safe) and returns the error. `off` publishes
    `off` and does nothing else. Auto needs `auto_eligible`, non-nil τ, and model/policy/candidates hashes equal to
    this run's; otherwise `dry_run` plus a `Result.Warnings` line. τ from the calibration, else 0.8.
  - Per txn (newest first, `MaxPerRun` default 50, `BacklogDays` default 45): current-decision check (key = run's
    `ModelID` + hashes + effective mode) → AutoSince (effective auto) → `Guard` → rules → one batched model call →
    τ split → second opinion on misses only → one batched `Apply` (actor `system`, via `scheduler`, `Approve: true`,
    `DecidedCategoryID` = category at decision time) or a question. In auto, τ-pass also requires
    `Prediction.Model == ModelID`.
  - Questions are inserted `pending` (superseding any live question on the txn, reason `superseded`) and then posted
    oldest-first while open < `QuestionCap` (default 5). Entering effective auto closes all open+pending
    `dry_run_check` rows with `superseded_by_auto` and edits the posted ones via `Asker.Closed`.
  - `classify/pipeline_test.go`: real temp SQLite store + fakes for Model, Applier, Asker.
- Acceptance:
  - Path table (guard skip, rule, τ pass, τ miss) → pass, `go test ./classify -run TestRun_Paths`
  - Model error / null result: no decision or question, retried next run → pass, `TestRun_ModelErrorRetriesNextRun`
  - Dry-run never calls Applier → pass, `TestRun_DryRunNeverApplies`
  - Auto with mismatched model/policy/candidates, `auto_eligible=false` or nil τ → dry_run + warning → pass, `TestRun_AutoDowngrades`
  - Second opinion at p=1.0 can't apply; a failed one still asks → pass, `TestRun_SecondOpinionNeverApplies`
  - 6th question stays pending, posts when a slot frees, model called once → pass, `TestRun_QuestionCap`
  - Decided txn not re-sent → pass, `TestRun_DecidedNotResent`
  - Auto + older than AutoSince: neither applied nor asked (nor sent to the model) → pass, `TestRun_AutoSince`
  - Entering auto closes open+pending dry_run_check rows, posts none → pass, `TestRun_EnteringAutoClosesDryRunChecks`
  - Setter before any Applier call, incl. downgrade and off → pass, `TestRun_SetterBeforeApplier`
  - dry_run decision not current in auto; return from downgrade re-decides and closes the older question → pass, `TestRun_ModeChangeRedecides`
  - `go list -deps ./classify | grep -c YNAB_AutoCategorizer/calibrate` → 0
  - `go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./...` → green (also `go test -race ./classify -run TestRun_`)
- Deviations from brief:
  - Guardrail and before-AutoSince skips are logged as `decisions` rows with `method='rule'`, `outcome='skipped'` and
    the reason in `features.skip` (the schema allows only rule/model). Every row in a run carries the run's `ModelID`
    in `model`, so "current" is one key for all rows (rule rows included).
  - Writer outcomes: `done`/`unknown` → `applied` (unknown is left to `Reconcile`), `skipped` → `skipped` decision
    with `features.write_reason`, `failed` or a batch error → no decision (retried next run).
  - "would apply X" / "would ask" and the second-opinion hint are carried in `QuestionOption.Label` (e.g.
    `Groceries (would apply)`, `Discretionary (second opinion)`); a hint outside the top-3 is appended as an extra
    option. No `slack/` edits.
  - Supervisor note (model id): `Config.SecondOpinionModelID`, when set, is recorded in `second_opinion.model` instead
    of `Prediction.Model` (`llm.ModelID`, hardcoded). cmd should pass the runner's real model id.
- Follow-ups for backlog:
  - `slack/`: `*slack.Questions` needs a `Closed(ctx, q, reason) error` (export/wrap `finish`) to satisfy
    `classify.Asker`; it already has `Ask`. Optionally render a verdict/hint line for dry_run_check instead of relying
    on option labels.
  - `llm/`: expose the model the CLI actually used (e.g. from the JSON output's model usage) instead of the hardcoded
    `ModelID`, so cmd can set `SecondOpinionModelID` from it.
  - M3-14b wiring: `SetMode: func(m writer.Mode){ gate.Set(m) }`; copy `calibrate.Current()` fields into
    `classify.Calibration`; `ModelID` = the pinned Jev id; `HistoryPlanIDs` = active + archived plans with
    Discretionary; config for `CLASSIFY_BACKLOG_DAYS`, max-per-run and question cap.
